page.description: Puppy Linux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A unique family of lightweight Linux distributions created by Barry Kauler in 2003. Each variant is typically under 1.5 GB, designed to run entirely in RAM for fast performance on older hardware.
pros: Runs entirely in RAM for exceptional speed
Multiple variants for different use cases and hardware ages
cons: Official download mirrors (Ibiblio, NLUUG) only contain old pet packages, no current ISOs
Download collection page (forum.puppylinux.com) requires JavaScript to render – no usable links found via HEAD/GET
No current ISO download URL could be verified for any Puppy Linux variant
The main site refuses requests and the mirrors carry only old package sets, so no current ISO can be pinned.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Puppy Linux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Official website and all known mirrors fail to provide downloadable ISOs. The project appears active (pet packages updated through 2026) but pre-built ISO downloads are inaccessible.
